notes.title: Error_Boy.exe Demo 1.1.0.0 Update
notes.notes:
Due to a functionality modification, a bug occurred where the game could not progress when using a module in the tutorial.
This issue has been fixed.

notes.title: Error_Boy.exe Demo 1.0.9.9 Update
notes.notes:
• Cloud save is supported.
• Only two characters are playable in the demo.
• A secret room has been added.
• Defeating a boss now clears all monsters and bullet patterns in the room.
• Text events have been added for boss encounters and defeats.
• The "Chicken" boss pattern in Stage 1, "Medieval Voyager," has been revised.
• The event UI for Stage 3, "Doki Girls," has been updated.
• More types of regular monster rooms have been added.

Thank you!

notes.title: Error_Boy.exe Demo 1.0.8 Update
notes.notes:
[b]- You can choose from a variety of characters to play. [/b]
Unselectable characters will be unlocked when certain conditions are met.

[b]- Active item added. [/b]
It can be used as a space bar.

[b]- Synergy between items was realized. [/b]
There are only a few so far, but they will continue to be added in the future.

[b]- The basic enemy's strength went down. [/b]

[b]- Add other items and fix bugs [/b]

notes.title: A demo version of Error_Boy.exe is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello! I'm Walnut Punch, developer of Error_Boy.exe.

A demo version of Error_Boy.exe is coming soon!

I'm in the inspection stage on Steam, so I don't know the exact date, but I expect a demo release before April 15.

It's not a satisfactory stage yet

It's playable, so I'm revealing it to you.

The response to different languages can also be strange because I used a translator.

But I think it's better than not translating it!

I look forward to your kind cooperation!
